component.name: Greenlight (Rust)
component.summary: Stream games from your Xbox console or xCloud

description.p: A native xCloud and Xbox home streaming client, ported from Greenlight to Rust with GStreamer WebRTC. It is not affiliated with Microsoft or Xbox.

ul.li: Stream from your Xbox One or Xbox Series console
Stream xCloud titles with Game Pass Ultimate
Gamepad support with rumble, plus keyboard controls

description.p: This is a command line application: sign in with "greenlight login", then start a stream with "greenlight home CONSOLE_ID" or "greenlight cloud TITLE_ID".
